label: diffuse token-conjunction code, biased to early original steps after u/2
explanation: Active on 5% of steps, spread over both the original and copy phases; never at t=0 and almost never at the delimiter step. Rates are mildly enriched for input tokens a/c/t/1/s, for previous or two-back input u/2, and for t=2-3. The strongest activations (~0.45) come from sequences starting u 2 followed by t or c. No single predicate gets past dev F1 ~0.32. The best one (original phase, t in 1..4, u or 2 already seen) has precision 0.33 and mass recall 0.42. Single-token and previous-token sets each reach F1 below 0.25. This looks like a distributed hash of token identity and context, not a monosemantic feature.
